tool: built-in image_gen.imagegen; Pillow for lossless silhouette arrangement and raster exports
source_files: Unmodified generated social banner, unchanged user-supplied preferred silhouette reference, and a losslessly assembled silhouette master

social-banner.icon_scale_revision: Imagegen edit targeting 50% of the previous width and height for every footer icon; compact centered row.

game-silhouettes.revision: User-authorized lossless rearrangement of the preferred reference into chronological order. Every fragment and nontransparent reference pixel is preserved exactly in the assembled master. No redraw, recolouring or resampling; README display width remains 720 px.

reference.origin: User-selected earlier imagegen silhouette artwork, supplied as codex-clipboard-afb436bf-1caf-4eab-9257-0f5ecc1d31c5.png

game-silhouettes.export_crop: Crop to the assembled alpha >= 16 bounds and add 16 px of transparent margin. No pixel values inside the crop are changed.

compatibility_note: One emblem per title; MOHAA is standalone artwork and has no implemented engine profile.
chronology_basis: Original PC release chronology, ignoring later platform ports and storefront rereleases.
